name: Sighing Reed Marsh
introDiscord:
Long silver reeds cover a marsh where every passing current produces a
soft humanlike sigh. Sighing Reed Hunters move between them, hidden by
the sound of a forest that always seems to be breathing.
introTwitch:
Long silver reeds cover a marsh where every passing current produces a
soft humanlike sigh. Sighing Reed Hunters move between them, hidden by
the sound of a forest that always seems to be breathing.

sighing-reed-marsh-approach.prompt:
Three marsh trails disappear beneath tall reeds. Somewhere ahead, a
slow exhale does not match your breathing.

left.message:
One Berry rests inside Shizuki's abandoned reed whistle.

Her note reads:

'Made whistle.

Reeds answered.

Something else answered.

Whistle retired.'

right.message:
A shrine coffer lies beneath bent reeds. Star Candies inside barely
make a sound beneath the constant sighing marsh.

forward.message:
The reeds ahead bend.

Nothing emerges.

Then a Sighing Reed Hunter appears from the opposite direction.

The first movement was bait.

sighing-reed-marsh-depths.prompt:
Towering kelp fades behind a denser marsh. Three routes vanish beneath
reeds tall enough to hide nearly anything.

left.message:
A sigh passes through the reeds on your left.

Another answers on your right.

The Hunter comes from straight ahead.

right.message:
A moonblossom pool rests under a low reed shelter.

Shizuki wrote:

'If marsh copies your breathing, breathe normally.

I tried confusing it.

Nearly passed out.'
right.fullHpMessage: You leave the pool untouched and choose normal breathing. Innovative.

forward.message:
An offering basket is tied above the marsh floor. Inside are Star
Candies and several little reed whistles.

Do not.

sighing-reed-marsh-threshold.prompt:
Living roots lead toward Breathless Fen. The reeds surrounding the
three final routes have stopped sighing.

left.message:
Broad silver kelp wraps a Star Candy cache beneath perfectly still
reeds.

The silence makes opening it feel much louder than it is.

right.message:
One reed bends.

Then another.

The Sighing Reed Hunter is already standing between them.

forward.message:
Restorative sap rests inside Shizuki's retired whistle case.

'Whistle still retired.

Medicine promoted.'
forward.fullHpMessage: You leave the medicine and the whistle's retirement plan intact.

boss-antechamber.name: Breathless Fen
boss-antechamber.prompt: Every reed in the marsh goes completely silent.

bossPromptDiscord:
No sighs.

No current.

No copied breathing.

Breathless Fen becomes so still that the absence of sound feels louder
than the marsh itself.

Then a tall silhouette rises behind the reeds wearing a crown of silver
stalks.

Use /yes to enter the Fen or /no to retreat before the marsh exhales
again.
bossPromptTwitch:
No sighs.

No current.

No copied breathing.

Breathless Fen becomes so still that the absence of sound feels louder
than the marsh itself.

Then a tall silhouette rises behind the reeds wearing a crown of silver
stalks.

Use !yes to enter the Fen or !no to retreat before the marsh exhales
again.
bossRetreatText:
You back away from Breathless Fen. The reeds remain perfectly still
until you are far enough away.

Then one long sigh follows you out.

boss.revealText:
The silver reeds explode outward as a towering predator emerges.

Reed-Crowned Hunter reveals itself!

completionText:
"The Reed-Crowned Hunter disappears into the marsh.

The reeds begin sighing again.

This time, the sound feels almost peaceful."
